steps.title: The developer builds the app
steps.text: The developer compiles the two circuits, [[counter_init]] and [[counter_add]], hashes their verification keys, builds the contract manifest that lists them, draws a deployment salt and computes the contract's address. The address commits to the constructor's Config, so it commits to these circuits.

steps.title: REGISTER: the nodes take the circuits and derive the app's nullifier secret
steps.text: The developer sends the manifest and the circuits through the orchestrator to the three nodes. Each node stores them; together they derive the app's nullifier secret `nsk_app` as shares, which no node ever holds whole, and its public hash `npk_app_hash`. Each signs the registry answer over the namespace, the manifest hash, the package list, `npk_app_hash` and the sequence number.

steps.title: Alice prepares her request: secrets, partial note, C and the three sharings
steps.text: Alice's client (`requestOutcome`) derives `rho`, an outcome key and tag and a blinding from her wallet secret (`SecretStore`). It computes her partial note P, the commitment C over [amount, P, key, tag] and the blinding, and the request id. It splits the five values into three summand vectors, salts and hashes each into S_j, hashes the three into D, and seals each node's two vectors to that node.

steps.title: Alice's request transaction: add checks the sharing and the receipts, append_receipt queues it
steps.text: Alice's wallet runs [[add]]: it commits her partial note and pushes its use nullifier, checks that the summands add up to the values behind C, recomputes D and C, checks the amount is a u64, computes the request id and checks the three receipts. It enqueues [[assert_key_epoch]] and [[append_receipt]], which queues the request id. Only the request id and the expiry reach the chain. Her wallet's send returns once the transaction is in a proposed block.

steps.text: Each node opens its envelope into its parts of the inputs and loads its parts of the counter state c0 and of `nsk_app`, as the manifest says. The three compare hashes of what they hold in common, so they hold one sharing, and draw the new blinding r1 together. [[counter_add]]'s parameters are now filled.

steps.title: The nodes prove counter_add together
steps.text: The three nodes run [[counter_add]] as a co-SNARK: C opens, 0 + 5 fits a u64, so the code is 0 and the new total 5 is written under r1. The round completes Alice's partial note with [0, 5, request id] and seals [0, 5] to her outcome key. Each node checks the proof, signs the result over the machine request id and c1 when the round ends, without reading the chain again, and keeps its parts of the new state.

steps.title: The relayer lands the result: process_result enqueues apply_result
steps.text: The relayer's wallet runs [[process_result]]: it verifies the co-SNARK proof under the pinned [[counter_add]] vk and the three node signatures, pushes Alice's completed note hash and emits her sealed outcome log. It enqueues two public calls, which run after it: [[assert_key_epoch]] (the signatures' key set is still valid) and [[apply_result]], which checks that the head is this request and the counter still holds c0, then writes c1 and moves the head. Nothing in the transaction names Alice. The relayer's send returns once the transaction is in a proposed block.

[[k-configured|configured]] → [[process_result]]: the counter_add vk hash, npk_app_hash, the node keys
[[process_result]] → [[p-log|outcome log]]: tag `0x1c77…20aa`, the note hash, the 3-field ciphertext
[[k-ctr|counter]] → Node i: each node's chain reader sees c1 land and moves its parts of [[nd-c1|c1]] to long-lived

learns.text: That the request at queue index 0 was applied: c1, the moved head, done[0]. One new note hash and one tagged log that nobody else can open and that name nobody. The relayer's account as fee payer. Not the amount, the total or who asked.
The co-SNARK proof, its verification key and the three node signatures: they are checked inside the relayer's private function, and only the wallet's proof of that function reaches the chain.
Nothing new: it already held the result it fetched at step 15.
That the result landed. Each node moves its parts of c1 to long-lived state.
Nothing yet. She polls at step 17 and opens her outcome at step 18.
The amount 5, the new total 5 and Alice's outcome key. Still not her account address.

steps.title: Alice sees her request applied
steps.text: Alice's client polls the queue at the proposed tip (`waitForRequest`): done[0] is 1, so her request was applied (2 would mean it was skipped as stale).

learns.text: Her request landed. Everyone could see that index 0 landed; only she knows it was hers.

steps.title: Alice opens her outcome and stores her note
steps.text: Alice's client (`readAndDeliverOutcome`) finds the outcome log by her tag, derives the nonce from the note hash it carries and decrypts [code 0, total 5] with her outcome key. It rebuilds the completed note from P, the plaintext and the request id, compares its hash with the note hash the log carries, and [[deliver_outcome]] hands the note to her PXE. No transaction.

flows.text: [[p-log|outcome log]] → Alice: found by tag `0x1c77…20aa`, opened with her outcome key

learns.text: The total after her add: 5. Nobody else learns it.
